expectation: The disk interaction will reveal how the gas and dust escape into the galaxy.

effect: The exposed disk interaction returned gas and dust to the nursery, completing the remaining goal and clarifying that this happened early in the system’s history.
reaction: I appreciated the contrast between the early gas escape and the rocky world’s later impacts.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the escaping disk material was most worthwhile: it connected the planetary system back to its galactic surroundings and clarified the timing.

leastWorthwhile.text: The projectile encounter was fairly predictable: the world kept its moon as expected.

surprise.text: The disk material escaped early, while the retained rocky bodies still had a long history of collisions ahead.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt particularly arbitrary; both followed directly from the visible goals and pieces.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the link between the system’s early disk loss and the later history of its worlds left me curious about what happens next.
